issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `_detect_errors(measurements, checks)` (problem_statement.md), but both the provided template and the reference solution define the function as `detect_errors(measurements, checks)` (no leading underscore). This naming mismatch between the textual task and the code will confuse students about which symbol to implement and will cause tests or autograder checks that expect `detect_errors` to fail if students implement `_detect_errors` instead.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the problem statement to request `detect_errors(measurements, checks)` (no leading underscore) so it matches the template and solution. Alternatively, change the template and solution function name to `_detect_errors` and update tests/autograder accordingly; ensure all references (problem text, tests, and solution) use the same name.
